newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs hampered by year end, tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs hampered by year end, tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures had an uninspired session on Monday due to a lack of participation on the last day of the Japanese financial year.
Dealers said activity was also inhibited by a reluctance to take fresh positions ahead of the Bank of Japan's quarterly business sentiment survey, or tankan, due on Wednesday.
"If the diffusion index (on the tankan) is unchanged to slightly negative, the Euroyen and JGBs will soar and the Nikkei will take another plunge," said a dealer at a European house.
He said disappointment over the details of the Japanese government's plans to boost land liquidity underpinned Euroyen and JGB markets.
December Euroyen was quoted at 99.04 at 1115 GMT against its IMM close at 99.03 on light volume of 1,440 lots.
June JGBs settled at 125.90 against their previous 125.61 after hitting a high of 125.95.
"It looks like 125.50 is a good support and there's resistance at 126.30," said a trader with a Japanese house.

Eurodollar futures ended steady in cautious trade ahead of a slew of U.S. economic data, including the National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index on Tuesday and the non-farm payrolls report on Friday.

"People are looking for the NAPM to show further strength in the manufacturing sector," said the trader with the European house. He said expectations of strong economic data were fuelling fears of another U.S. interest rate hike in the coming months.
June Eurodollars ended unchanged against their IMM close at 93.995. September were also steady at 93.685.
